## Plans

### <a name="puppet_ca_utils--configure_ca_server_trust"></a>`puppet_ca_utils::configure_ca_server_trust`

Configures two CA servers for mutual trust

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `puppet_ca_utils::configure_ca_server_trust` plan:

* [`targets`](#-puppet_ca_utils--configure_ca_server_trust--targets)
* [`ca_hosts`](#-puppet_ca_utils--configure_ca_server_trust--ca_hosts)
* [`crl_bundle`](#-puppet_ca_utils--configure_ca_server_trust--crl_bundle)
* [`restart_puppetserver`](#-puppet_ca_utils--configure_ca_server_trust--restart_puppetserver)

##### <a name="-puppet_ca_utils--configure_ca_server_trust--targets"></a>`targets`

Data type: `TargetSpec`

The CA server targets that should be configured for mutual trust
relationships. Generally speaking, this should simply be the list of
Puppet CA servers that mutual trust should be established between.

##### <a name="-puppet_ca_utils--configure_ca_server_trust--ca_hosts"></a>`ca_hosts`

Data type: `TargetSpec`

The CA systems to gather trust information from. By default, this will
be the same as the set of targets. Sometimes it may be desirable to gather
trust data from multiple systems but only configure that trust on a
subset. This parameter enables that atypical use case.

Default value: `$targets`

##### <a name="-puppet_ca_utils--configure_ca_server_trust--crl_bundle"></a>`crl_bundle`

Data type: `Enum[full,api]`

How to build the CRL bundle. When set to 'full', the plan will run a task
on each ca_hosts target to collect the full CRL information. When set to
'api', the data gathered will be limited to data available from the Puppet
CA REST API.

Default value: `'full'`

##### <a name="-puppet_ca_utils--configure_ca_server_trust--restart_puppetserver"></a>`restart_puppetserver`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether or not to restart Puppet Server after reconfiguring it. Defaults
to false. Do not set this to true if using the orchestrator as the Bolt
transport.

Default value: `false`
